Welcome to HouseHelper

Set up your household

Create an adult profile for each parent, grandparent, or caregiver and a child profile for every child. Your dashboard will begin completely blank.

Adults & caregiversAdult profiles can approve chores and manage rewards.
Children & dependentsAdd as many as your household needs. This section may be empty.

Everything stays on this device unless you connect it to a household host. Removing a profile later hides it but does not erase its saved history.

Enter adult passcode

Passcodes protect adult actions across connected family devices. Passcodes are stored as one-way hashes, never as readable numbers.

Adult learning controls

Language goals & rewards

The goal counts unique cards reviewed that day. Repeating one card never fills the goal or speeds up long-term mastery.

Long-term mastery ruleRetained requires correct recall on at least 2 different days. Mastered requires at least 5 correct days spanning 14+ days, plus every scheduled review stage.
